entries.description_en: A document describing work and deliverables under a project.
entries.example_en: Define the scope of work before pricing.

entries.description_en: An approved modification to contractual scope or conditions.
entries.example_en: Issue a change order for the additional work.

entries.description_en: A contract provision explaining how an agreement may end.
entries.example_en: Review the termination clause.

entries.description_en: A right to extend a contract under stated conditions.
entries.example_en: The tenant exercised the renewal option.

entries.description_en: The law chosen to govern a contract.
entries.example_en: Confirm the governing law clause.

entries.description_en: The process used to settle disagreements.
entries.example_en: The contract provides for dispute resolution.

entries.description_en: A provision referring specified disputes to arbitration.
entries.example_en: Discuss the arbitration clause with counsel.

entries.description_en: A contractual duty to cover certain losses or claims.
entries.example_en: Clarify the indemnification obligations.

entries.description_en: Events beyond control affecting contractual performance.
entries.example_en: Review the force majeure provision.

entries.description_en: Information a party agrees to keep secret.
entries.example_en: Limit access to confidential information.

entries.description_en: Legal rights covering qualifying creative and technical work.
entries.example_en: Identify intellectual property rights in the contract.

entries.description_en: Written steps for carrying out a recurring task.
entries.example_en: Follow the standard operating procedure.

entries.description_en: An organized sequence of tasks and handoffs.
entries.example_en: Map the workflow before changing it.

entries.description_en: A constraint that limits system throughput.
entries.example_en: The approval stage became a bottleneck.

entries.description_en: Planning resources to meet expected demand.
entries.example_en: Capacity planning prevents overbooking.

entries.description_en: Assignment of people funds or equipment to tasks.
entries.example_en: Review resource allocation weekly.

entries.description_en: Changes intended to improve how work is performed.
entries.example_en: The team proposed a process improvement.

entries.description_en: A method for identifying why a problem occurred.
entries.example_en: Use root cause analysis before redesigning the process.

entries.description_en: A step taken to remove the cause of a problem.
entries.example_en: Record the corrective action.

entries.description_en: Scheduled work intended to prevent equipment failure.
entries.example_en: Preventive maintenance reduces downtime.

entries.description_en: Period when equipment or a service is unavailable.
entries.example_en: Track downtime by machine.

entries.description_en: Planned activities ensuring requirements can be met.
entries.example_en: Quality assurance starts during design.

entries.description_en: Inspection or testing that checks whether output meets requirements.
entries.example_en: Quality control rejected the batch.

entries.description_en: The manager responsible for a hiring decision.
entries.example_en: The hiring manager reviewed the applications.

entries.description_en: A document explaining a role's duties and expectations.
entries.example_en: Rewrite the job description.

entries.description_en: An agreement setting employment terms.
entries.example_en: The employee signed the employment contract.

entries.description_en: An initial period for evaluating employment suitability.
entries.example_en: The contract includes a probationary period.

entries.description_en: Nonwage compensation provided to employees.
entries.example_en: Compare employee benefits packages.

entries.description_en: The rate at which employees leave and are replaced.
entries.example_en: Employee turnover increased last year.

entries.description_en: Absence from work due to illness.
entries.example_en: She requested sick leave.

entries.description_en: Advancement to a higher position.
entries.example_en: The manager recommended a promotion.

entries.description_en: Money allocated to employee development.
entries.example_en: The training budget was approved.

entries.description_en: Work performed away from the employer's premises.
entries.example_en: The team permits remote work.

entries.description_en: How pleased customers are with a service or product.
entries.example_en: Survey customer satisfaction after delivery.

entries.description_en: A measure based on how likely customers are to recommend a business.
entries.example_en: Monitor the net promoter score.

entries.description_en: Loss of customers over a period.
entries.example_en: Customer churn declined this quarter.

entries.description_en: Time elapsed before a request receives a reply.
entries.example_en: The support team reduced response time.

entries.description_en: Solving a customer issue during the initial interaction.
entries.example_en: First-contact resolution improves service.

entries.description_en: A communication that a service is unavailable.
entries.example_en: Send a service outage notice.

entries.description_en: The process of receiving and resolving complaints.
entries.example_en: Train employees in complaint handling.

entries.description_en: A system rewarding repeat customer activity.
entries.example_en: Launch a customer loyalty program.

entries.description_en: A set of questions measuring customer experience.
entries.example_en: Send a satisfaction survey after the visit.

entries.description_en: The terms under which a business accepts returned goods.
entries.example_en: Publish a clear return policy.

entries.description_en: Terms granting permission to use computer software.
entries.example_en: Read the software license before deployment.

entries.description_en: Data storage provided through remote servers.
entries.example_en: Back up the reports to cloud storage.

entries.description_en: A defined way for software systems to exchange requests and data.
entries.example_en: The vendor provides an API.

entries.description_en: A record showing account or system access events.
entries.example_en: Review the access log.

entries.description_en: Access rights assigned to an account.
entries.example_en: Restrict user permissions by role.

entries.description_en: Rules defining how long data is kept.
entries.example_en: Follow the data retention policy.

entries.description_en: An event compromising or threatening systems or data.
entries.example_en: Report the cybersecurity incident.

entries.description_en: Coordinated actions taken to handle a security incident.
entries.example_en: Test the incident response plan.

entries.description_en: The process of releasing software for use.
entries.example_en: Schedule the software deployment.

entries.description_en: A procedure for restoring a previous working state.
entries.example_en: Prepare a rollback plan before release.
